صَعَرٌ inf. n. of 1 [q. v.]. ―
-b2- The saying فِى الصَّعَرِ الدِّيَةُ is expl. as meaning In [the case of] the distorting of the face [the whole bloodwit shall be exacted: as though the verb of which صَعَرٌ is the inf. n. were trans.; but this is obviously a loose rendering]. (Mgh.) ―
-b3- صَعَرٌ also signifies Pride: (Mgh:) or the being proud. (TA.) ―
-b4- And Smallness of the head: (K:) or the being small, said of a man's head: (K, * TA:) one says, صَعِرَ رَأْسُهُ, inf. n. صَعَرٌ, meaning his head was small. (TK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
